A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at Num.13.7; 
father of: Igal (H3008)
§ Joseph = "Jehovah has added"
1) the eldest son of Jacob by Rachel
2) father of Igal, who represented the tribe of Issachar among the spies
3) a son of Asaph
4) a man who took a foreign wife in the time of Ezra
5) a priest of the family of Shebaniah in the time of Nehemiah

A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Ezr.10.18; 
father of: Jeshua (H3442)
§ Jozadak = "Jehovah is righteous"
grandson of the high priest Hilkiah; son of the high priest Seraiah; and father of the high priest Joshua; he never attained the office of high priest himself because he was carried captive to Babylon by Nebuchadnezzar (in Aramaic writings)

1) early rain, autumn shower
1a) rain which falls in Palestine from late October until early December

§ Jorah = "he instructs"
